items.source:
This implementation delegates to a SavepointManager for the
underlying transaction, if possible.
items.translation: 此实现会尽可能将底层事务委托给 SavepointManager。

items.source: NestedTransactionNotSupportedException - if the underlying transaction does not support savepoints
items.translation: NestedTransactionNotSupportedException - 如果底层事务不支持保存点

items.source: This method is mainly here for diagnostic purposes, alongside TransactionExecution.isNewTransaction(). For programmatic handling of custom savepoints, use the operations provided by SavepointManager.
items.translation: 此方法主要用于诊断目的，与TransactionExecution.isNewTransaction()一起使用。对于自定义保存点的程序化处理，请使用SavepointManager提供的操作。

items.source: Pre-implements the handling of local rollback-only and completed flags, and delegation to an underlying SavepointManager. Also offers the option of a holding a savepoint within the transaction.
items.translation: 预实现了对本地回滚标记和完成标志的处理，以及委托给底层 SavepointManager 接口。此外，还提供了在事务中保存检查点（savepoint）的选项。

items.source: The default implementation returns false.
items.translation: 默认实现返回false。

items.source:
Does not assume any specific internal transaction handling, such as an
underlying transaction object, and no transaction synchronization mechanism.
items.translation: 不假设任何特定的内部事务处理，例如底层事务对象，且无事务同步机制。

items.source: Default implementation always throws a NestedTransactionNotSupportedException.
items.translation: 默认实现始终抛出 NestedTransactionNotSupportedException。

items.source: Create a savepoint and hold it for the transaction.
items.translation: 创建保存点并将其保留在事务中。

items.source: Get the savepoint for this transaction, if any.
items.translation: 获取此事务的保存点（如果有）。

items.source:
Determine the rollback-only flag via checking both the local rollback-only flag
of this TransactionStatus and the global rollback-only flag of the underlying
transaction, if any.
items.translation: 通过检查此 TransactionStatus 的本地回滚标志以及底层事务（如有）的全局回滚标志，来确定回滚仅标志。

items.source: Release the savepoint that is held for the transaction.
items.translation: 释放事务中持有的保存点。

items.source:
Roll back to the savepoint that is held for the transaction
and release the savepoint right afterwards.
items.translation: 回滚到为该事务持有的保存点，并随后释放该保存点。

items.source: Mark this transaction as completed, that is, committed or rolled back.
items.translation: 将此事务标记为已完成，即提交或回滚。

items.source: Set a savepoint for this transaction. Useful for PROPAGATION_NESTED.
items.translation: 为此事务设置保存点。对 PROPAGATION_NESTED 很有用。

Return whether this transaction internally carries a savepoint,
that is, has been created as nested transaction based on a savepoint.
items.translation: 返回此事务内部是否携带保存点，即是否已基于保存点创建为嵌套事务。

items.source:
Return whether this transaction is completed, that is,
whether it has already been committed or rolled back.
items.translation: 返回此事务是否已完成，即它是否已经提交或回滚。
